env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache

# A Go-derived package-level var keeps its platform origin across a
# package boundary (SPEC Sec 2.2, T-202). lib.P holds os.Stdout under an
# inferred *os.File type; the producing package records the derivation
# in its export facts, so the importer's typed_nil_return check reports
# the cross-package return exactly like the same-package ones. Without
# the facts record (stale archives) the importer stays silent.
cd m
! logos lint ./...
stderr -count=3 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr 'platform pointer P \(\*os\.File\)'
stderr 'platform pointer Q \(\*os\.File\)'
stderr 'platform pointer lib\.P \(\*os\.File\)'
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=1 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr 'lib[/\\]lib\.lgo:\d+:\d+: \[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/derived

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"io"
	"os"
)

var P = os.Stdout

func Get() io.Closer {
	return P
}

-- m/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"io"
	"os"

	"example.com/derived/lib"
)

var Q = os.Stdout

func Local() io.Closer {
	return Q
}

func Imported() io.Closer {
	return lib.P
}

func main() {
	_ = Local()
	_ = Imported()
	_ = lib.Get()
}
